# deeper than

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:deeperThan`](gmeow-deeperThan.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/deeperThan>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/cognition`](../../slices/cognition.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Orders the knowledge-depth axis: relates a knowledge level to a shallower one it surpasses ([`knowledgeMastered`](../individuals/gmeow-knowledgeMastered.md) [`gmeow:deeperThan`](gmeow-deeperThan.md) [`knowledgeUnderstands`](../individuals/gmeow-knowledgeUnderstands.md)). Transitive ON LEVELS ONLY (the [`gmeow:coarserThan`](gmeow-coarserThan.md) / [`gmeow:moreSevereThan`](gmeow-moreSevereThan.md) pattern) — [`KnowledgeProficiency`](../classes/gmeow-KnowledgeProficiency.md) relators are never ordered by it.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:KnowledgeLevel`](../classes/gmeow-KnowledgeLevel.md) -> [`gmeow:KnowledgeLevel`](../classes/gmeow-KnowledgeLevel.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:deeperThan`](gmeow-deeperThan.md) from [`gmeow:KnowledgeLevel`](../classes/gmeow-KnowledgeLevel.md) to [`gmeow:KnowledgeLevel`](../classes/gmeow-KnowledgeLevel.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to order two [`gmeow:KnowledgeLevel`](../classes/gmeow-KnowledgeLevel.md) values so 'at or above a target depth' is well-defined for queries over reified proficiencies — the knowledge-axis analogue of the kernel [`gmeow:coarserThan`](gmeow-coarserThan.md) ladder.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting it between [`gmeow:KnowledgeProficiency`](../classes/gmeow-KnowledgeProficiency.md) relators (only the levels are ordered, never the relators) and avoid using it to order ratings on a foreign scale (Bloom's, SOLO); cross-framework correspondence is a soft ledger, not this transitive order.

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:deeperThan`](gmeow-deeperThan.md) from the deeper level to the shallower one and let transitivity build the four-rung ladder; query a relator's [`gmeow:knowledgeProficiencyLevel`](gmeow-knowledgeProficiencyLevel.md) against this order to find every proficiency at or above a depth.
